passes.name: Concept Pass
passes.rule: Choose one fresh product-relevant social idea; reject background swaps, centered packshots and category clichés.

passes.name: Social Layout Pass
passes.rule: Assemble the exact product with an asymmetric 4:5 mobile grid, at least three visible 2D brand-design layers and a compact information zone.

passes.name: Quality Pass
passes.rule: Reject plain renders, enlarged duplicate-package backgrounds, generic glossy scenes, altered products, invented copy, bad typography and repeated variations.

commands.label: Ad3X Instagram Creative
commands.instruction: Run all three Ad3X passes and return one separate finished 4:5 Instagram post.

commands.label: Ad3X Fresh Concept
commands.instruction: Run Ad3X from a blank canvas with a genuinely new concept family.

commands.label: Ad3X Product Ad
commands.instruction: Run Ad3X with absolute product identity lock and conversion-focused social composition.
